insight.headline: Order Update Taxes
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the order's tax calculations and ensures accuracy. The update is available as of August 31, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware of this change and test their implementations to ensure correct tax calculations. The mutation now returns the updated tax amounts, which may impact the overall order total. No migration is required, but developers should review their code to handle potential tax changes. The GraphQL Admin API is affected, specifically the orderUpdate mutation.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses on unfulfilled orders, ensuring compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures merchants are compliant with tax regulations, reducing potential errors and discrepancies.
insight.code_example: mutation orderUpdate($input: OrderInput!) { orderUpdate(input: $input) { order { total { amount } } } }

themes.title: Hydrogen updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. Additionally, @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen have been updated with patch changes.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API updates
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. The Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Ecosystem updates
themes.detail: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, and the shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement. Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, and Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated.
